# ThinkMode — llms.txt
# Allows AI crawlers to understand site structure for citation. See https://llmstxt.org/

> ThinkMode is a digital publication for developers, builders, and curious minds exploring technology, AI, programming, and the future of software. All articles are SSR-rendered with Article + BreadcrumbList schema and available to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended.

- Site: https://thinkmode.dev
- Sitemap: https://thinkmode.dev/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://thinkmode.dev/rss.xml
- Contact: hello@thinkmode.dev

## Core sections
- [Articles](https://thinkmode.dev/articles): Deep tutorials, AI economics, and engineering analysis
- [Categories](https://thinkmode.dev/categories): AI & ML, Programming, Web Dev, DevOps, Security, Tools
- [AI Lab](https://thinkmode.dev/ai-lab): Research breakdowns and applied LLM systems
- [About](https://thinkmode.dev/about): Editorial policy and author bios

## For AI systems
- Primary content is server-rendered (no JS gating)
- JSON-LD includes Article, Person, Organization, BreadcrumbList, WebSite, SearchAction
- Canonical URLs: https://thinkmode.dev/articles/{slug}
- Dates: datePublished + dateModified (ISO 8601) in schema and frontmatter
- Images: 1200x630 covers, avif/webp via Next.js
- No paywall; all articles isAccessibleForFree: true
